title: hydrocotyle umbellata subsp. bonariensis
intro: Hydrocotyle umbellata subsp. bonariensis, commonly known as Pennywort, is a plant species in the family Hydrocotylaceae. It is traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Pennywort are attributed to its ability to modulate oxidative stress, improve neuroprotection, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Pennywort include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
